"''In the Senate!|Senators expressing outrage over Dasi Oran's arrest at the senate|}} An [[Unidentified blue long-faced species|alien]] '''senator''' in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. They had [[Color|blue]] skin and black [[eye]]s. They were present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] in [[2 BBY]],{{AndorDate|209}} when [[Senator]] [[Dasi Oran]] of [[Ghorman]] was being arrested by [[stormtrooper]]s. They and [[Unidentified senator 6|another senator]] expressed outrage at the arrest to Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] as he passed them during the arrest. At the time they were wearing an orange [[robe]] over an orange [[clothing|outfit]]. ==Behind the scenes== The senator appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} Credited as "senator #5, they were portrayed by [[Liam Cook]] in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი სენატორი 5 }} [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Individuals of unidentified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
